meta.figma_file: Native One File Pilot Design System
meta.theme: Color Light/Dark x OS iOS/Android x Language EN/AR (modes, no variants)

source.method: Claude pilot extraction + Codex scoped Profile update from FigCli Yolo

components.name: Button
components.use: Main action on a screen (Primary), alternative actions (Secondary), low emphasis or inline actions (Text).

use_cases: Save changes at the end of a settings screen
Confirm or continue in a flow
Secondary choice next to the main action
Low-emphasis action inside a bar or dialog
when_to_use: One Primary button for the main action of the screen
Secondary for an alternative action next to it
Text for low-emphasis actions in bars and dialogs
when_not_to_use: Icon-only actions (use Icon Button)
Moving to another screen from a list row (use List Item)
Turning a setting on or off (use Toggle)

guidelines.do: Keep one Primary button per screen for the main action.
guidelines.dont: Put two Primary buttons next to each other.

guidelines.do: Write the label as a short verb in sentence case.

dont_args.Label: CLICK HERE TO EDIT YOUR PROFILE

guidelines.do: Add a Leading Icon only when it adds meaning.
guidelines.dont: Add an icon just to decorate the button.

components.name: Icon Button
components.use: Compact action shown only as an icon (toolbar and top bar actions, close, search).

use_cases: Settings or search action in the Top App Bar
Close a sheet or dialog
One prominent floating action (Filled)
when_to_use: The icon meaning is universal: search, close, settings, back
Standard in bars, Filled for one prominent action
when_not_to_use: The action needs words to be understood (use Button with a label)
More than one Filled Icon Button on a screen

guidelines.do: Use a universal icon and give it an accessibility label in code.
guidelines.dont: Use an icon whose meaning users must guess.
Use Filled for routine bar actions.

content: No visible text: the label lives in code (accessibility label)

components.name: Segment
components.use: One option inside a Segmented Control. Not used on its own.

use_cases: One option of a Segmented Control (Light / Dark / Auto)
when_to_use: Only inside a Segmented Control
when_not_to_use: On its own as a button (use Button)
As a tab between screens

guidelines.do: Keep labels to one or two words.

content: No icons (Android adds the selected check automatically)

components.name: Segmented Control
components.use: Switches between 2-4 views or filters of the same content.

use_cases: Appearance: Light / Dark / Auto
Switch a list between Day / Week / Month
when_to_use: 2 to 4 views or filters of the same content
Exactly one option is selected at a time
when_not_to_use: More than 4 options (use Tabs or Select)
Actions (use Button)
Settings that turn on or off (use Toggle)

guidelines.do: Use 2 to 4 short options of similar length.
guidelines.dont: Squeeze in a fourth option that is not needed.

components.name: Top App Bar
components.use: Top of every screen: title, back navigation and up to one action.
issues: Properties are exposed from the nested private set _Top App Bar Platform; its Platform variant is bound to OS::Platform/Name.

use_cases: Title and back navigation at the top of every screen
Large title on the first screen of a section (iOS)
One secondary action such as settings
when_to_use: At the top of every screen
Show Back on every screen below the first
Large Title on top-level iOS screens
when_not_to_use: The private _Top App Bar Platform set directly
More than one action (move the rest to a menu or the screen)

guidelines.do: Keep the title to 1 to 3 words.
guidelines.dont: Use a sentence as the title.

dont_args.Title: Change the settings of your account

guidelines.do: Show the action only for the screen's main secondary action.
guidelines.dont: Show an action that duplicates something on the screen.

content: iOS Back Label is the previous screen's name or Back

components.name: Toggle
components.use: Turns a single setting on or off with immediate effect.

use_cases: Notifications on or off
Dark mode on or off in settings
when_to_use: A single setting that applies at once
Inside a List Item with the label as its Title
when_not_to_use: Choices confirmed later with a button (use Checkbox)
Choosing one of several options (use Segmented Control or Radio)

guidelines.do: Apply the change immediately when it is toggled.
guidelines.dont: Pair a Toggle with a Save button.

content: The label lives in the List Item Title, not inside the toggle

components.name: Checkbox
components.use: Selects one or more items from a list, or confirms an option before submitting.

use_cases: Pick several items in a list
Accept terms before submitting
when_to_use: Multi-select
Options confirmed by a later action
when_not_to_use: Settings that apply at once (use Toggle)
One choice from 2 to 6 options (use Radio)
One choice from 7 or more options (use Select)

guidelines.do: Use it when the user confirms the choice later.
guidelines.dont: Use it for a setting that should apply at once.

content: The label lives in the List Item Title

components.name: Text Field
components.use: Single-line text entry in forms and settings (names, email, search terms).

use_cases: Display name on a profile
Email or search term in a form
when_to_use: Single-line text entry
Always with a Label
Helper Text when the format needs explaining
when_not_to_use: Long text over several lines
Picking from 7 or more fixed options (use Select)
Picking from 2 to 6 options (use Radio)

guidelines.dont: Use the placeholder as the label.

guidelines.do: In the Error state, replace the helper text with what to fix.
guidelines.dont: Show an error with color only and no message.

content: Error message says how to fix it

components.name: List Item
components.use: One row in a list or settings group: navigates (Chevron, Value), toggles a setting (Toggle) or selects (Checkbox).

use_cases: A row in a settings group
Open a detail screen (Chevron, Value)
Turn a setting on or off (Toggle)
Select items (Checkbox)
when_to_use: Rows of a list or settings group, stacked with no gap
Chevron or Value rows that open a new screen
Toggle rows that apply at once
when_not_to_use: A single action button (use Button)
Long content that needs more than 2 lines of supporting text

guidelines.do: Turn Show Separator off on the last row of a group.
guidelines.dont: Leave a separator under the last row.

guidelines.do: Keep the Title to one line.
guidelines.dont: Put a long sentence in the Title.

dont_args.Title: Receive notifications about everything that happens

components.name: Pattern/Settings Screen
components.use: Reference Settings screen for the one-file native method: the same screen renders as iOS or Android through the OS mode.

use_cases: Reference for building a settings screen once for iOS and Android
Check that a screen follows the OS, Color and Language modes
when_to_use: As the model for screens built only from DS instances
Set OS, Color and Language modes on the screen frame
when_not_to_use: Detaching instances to fake a platform look
Building a separate iOS and Android copy of the same screen

guidelines.do: Build the screen once and switch the modes to see each platform.
guidelines.dont: Duplicate the screen for iOS and Android.

content: Real content in every instance, no placeholder text

components.name: Avatar
components.use: Initials identity fallback next to an account name.
issues: Avatar size aliases need user approval; see profile audit.

components.name: Profile Header
components.use: Account identity with Edit profile action.
issues: Android Button expanded touch area pending token approval.

components.name: Pattern/Profile Screen
components.use: Native account profile with eight OS/Color/Language previews.
issues: Two profile audit decisions pending; user review pending.

private_components.name: _Top App Bar Platform
private_components.note: Private: used only inside Top App Bar.
